Scene: a peaceful clear stream at sunrise beside a meadow and a small forest edge. Living things are connected by thin, softly glowing golden threads like a gentle web: grass and leafy plants, a grasshopper, a green caterpillar on a leaf, a frog on a stone, a sparrow on a reed, a small grass snake resting far back in the grass, and orange mushrooms on an old stump. The threads run from plants to the grasshopper and caterpillar, from those to the frog and sparrow, and from the frog and sparrow to the snake; the mushrooms glow softly on the stump. Nobody is eating anyone; the scene is calm.
Characters (match the attached references exactly): Moa, a cheerful Korean girl ecology explorer about 10, sage-green bucket hat with a leaf pin, sage-green field jacket, olive neckerchief, tan crossbody satchel, field notebook, olive cargo pants, brown boots, standing on a dirt path in the lower right third, smiling at the scene; Doto, a small orange tabby kitten with a dark-green neckerchief and gold leaf button, beside her feet looking up.
